scenario: Damage requires human review and must not be negated.
question: I bought the item 10 days ago. It is unused, I have the receipt, and it is damaged. Can I get a return?

reference.referenceEvidence: Because the item is damaged, the case requires human review.
reference.rationale: The answer separates standard-condition eligibility from approval and requires human review for damage.
reference.annotationSource: Project semantic reference annotations prepared by an isolated subtask from the approved policy and rule definitions before reviewer execution; not a verified human blind review.

originalResponse: The standard return policy requires an unused item, within 30 days of purchase, with a receipt. A purchase age of 10 days is within the 30-day window, and the supplied facts meet the standard return conditions; this is not a refund approval. Because the item is damaged, the case requires human review. Please contact human support.
